text: Cluster 25 aggregates (#6040, #6041) implemented on fix/currency-aggregates, stacked on the Currency overflow branch (#6037) which sits on #6751 (Currency functions, review fixes pushed). One shared AggregateAccumulator now serves CALCULATE, the SUM/AVERAGE commands and SQL (plain and GROUP BY): Currency SUM/AVG stay Currency and exact (overflow 1988), MIN/MAX return Date/DateTime/Character with their own type, SUM/AVG of a non-numeric are error 27 (1811 in SQL). New VFP9 findings: CALCULATE/AVERAGE truncate the Currency average toward zero while SQL AVG rounds half away from zero. Known gaps left open and documented: typed empty-set results, SQL AVG of an Integer (VFP truncates), and SELECT ... INTO CURSOR is not supported for these queries (the runtime reports a misleading 'INSERT INTO SELECT query could not be parsed' message). Filed as #6752 (SQL AVG of Integer) and #6753 (SELECT INTO CURSOR).
